build_VectorEncoder: build a VectorEncoder component to encode feature vectors using a linear layer with optional preprocessing function
build_Embedding: build an Embedding component to embed a single int32 feature into a float32 vector using hk.Embed
build_FixedLengthToMask: build a FixedLengthToMask component to convert a fixed-length integer list into a boolean mask array
build_ClockFeatureEncoder: build a ClockFeatureEncoder component to encode game clock values using sine-wave positional encoding
build_Logits: build a Logits component to produce scalar head logits using a configurable MLP with layer normalization
